blind.description: A classical rectangular stone altar or communion table made of polished beige marble with golden-brass architectural accents. It features a thick, beveled marble tabletop resting on a recessed body detailed with recessed panels separated by miniature square-profile brass/bronze pilasters at the corners and along the front. The structure sits upon a stepped marble base plinth that rests flat against the floor. All surfaces and geometry are solid, continuous, and clean.
blind.from_above: A simple rectangular beige-and-grey mottled marble slab with sharp, clean outer edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About waist-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 3 to 3.5 feet tall), and about 5 to 6 feet long by 2.5 feet wide.
